n7ef046ecfb.headline: Pakistan’s GDP to grow over 3% in FY26, says SBP
n7ef046ecfb.summary: SBP Governor Jameel Ahmad said Pakistan's economy is becoming more stable, with growth projected at 3.25% to 4.25% in FY2026. He spoke at the Pakistan Textile Council's annual meeting in Karachi.
n7ef046ecfb.why: The State Bank of Pakistan is the country's central bank, and its growth outlook shapes expectations for monetary policy and investment in Pakistan.

n724b8286ca.summary: The rand traded at 17.7350 per dollar, about 0.6% weaker than Monday's close, as investors awaited US data that could influence the Federal Reserve's rate decision this month.
n724b8286ca.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns.

n17333b8e4c.summary: Gemini Space Station, a global crypto platform, has launched an initial public offering of 16,666,667 shares. The offering marks a public listing for the crypto exchange.
n17333b8e4c.why: Gemini is a New York-based cryptocurrency exchange, and its listing offers investors direct exposure to a regulated crypto trading business.

n00163ecf42.headline: South African retailer Shoprite earnings rise on festive, Easter demand
n00163ecf42.summary: Shoprite Holdings reported a 15.8% rise in full-year earnings, as customers stocked up on food during the festive and Easter seasons. Diluted headline EPS from continuing operations rose to 13.67 rand.
n00163ecf42.why: Shoprite is South Africa's largest supermarket chain, so its results are a key read on consumer spending and food retail in Africa's largest economy. It is a constituent of the Johannesburg exchange.

n971d8d73cf.headline: Cyprus inflation dips while euro area rises to 2.1 per cent
n971d8d73cf.summary: Cyprus inflation is estimated to have fallen slightly in August 2025, with the annual rate at -0.1 per cent, Eurostat reported. Euro area inflation rose to 2.1 per cent.
n971d8d73cf.why: Inflation data shapes European Central Bank policy, which sets interest rates for the euro area that includes Cyprus. Investors track euro area price trends for rate and bond expectations.

n381f126569.headline: Keve and Oev find common ground with tax commissioner on reform plans
n381f126569.summary: The Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Employers and Industrialists Federation found common ground with Tax Commissioner Soteris Markides on proposed tax reform bills.
n381f126569.why: Tax reform in Cyprus affects corporate costs and the business climate, which matter to investors assessing the country's economic policy.

n4a9f95fe5f.headline: World Bank Urges Togo to Deepen Reforms and Boost Private Investment | Business
n4a9f95fe5f.summary: The World Bank urged Togo to deepen reforms and boost private investment, projecting growth of 5% in 2025 and 5.4% in 2026 despite global headwinds.
n4a9f95fe5f.why: World Bank growth projections and policy advice shape investor expectations for Togo's economy and its development financing.

n40332d49a0.headline: BPE to list DisCos, GenCo on stock market |
n40332d49a0.summary: BPE Director-General Ayodeji Gbeleyi said on Tuesday in Abuja that DisCos and GenCo entities will be listed on the stock market. The disclosure was made at a media briefing.
n40332d49a0.why: The Bureau of Public Enterprises manages Nigeria's state asset privatisations, and listings in the power sector would open these companies to public investors.

n1116c193a6.headline: Tariffs, migration and cartels will top Rubio's talks in Mexico and Ecuador this week
n1116c193a6.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio's agenda this week includes security, tariffs, trade, drugs and migration. The trip is his third to Latin America since becoming chief U.S. diplomat.
n1116c193a6.why: Tariffs and trade talks between the United States and Mexico affect cross-border supply chains and the outlook for Mexican exporters.

nccbb5ee0fb.headline: Quasar Medical Strengthens Global CDMO Platform with Acquisition of Nordson Medical’s Galway and Tecate Facilities
nccbb5ee0fb.summary: Quasar Medical announced it is acquiring Nordson Medical's facilities in Galway, Ireland and Tecate, Mexico, to strengthen its global contract development and manufacturing platform.
nccbb5ee0fb.why: Contract development and manufacturing organisations make medical devices for device makers, and facility acquisitions expand their capacity and service range.

nc73ee2d474.headline: Pak Army chief Munir meets China
nc73ee2d474.summary: Pakistan Army chief Asim Munir and PM Shehbaz Sharif met Xi Jinping in Beijing, discussing bilateral and regional cooperation, an upgraded CPEC and an upgraded free trade agreement.
nc73ee2d474.why: The China-Pakistan Economic Corridor is a flagship infrastructure and investment programme linking the two countries, so its terms matter for lenders, contractors and trade.

n65aa803204.headline: GenCos, NERC differ over enforcement of national grid code
n65aa803204.summary: Electricity Generation Companies have condemned moves by the Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission to compel them to install equipment under the national grid code. The dispute over enforcement is ongoing.
n65aa803204.why: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission oversees the country's power sector, and generation companies supply electricity to the national grid. Regulatory disputes affect the sector's operating costs and investment.

nb536ba6d13.headline: Ringgit ends lower ahead of Bank Negara's MPC meeting
nb536ba6d13.summary: The ringgit ended lower on Tuesday as market sentiment remained cautious. Traders are bracing for Bank Negara Malaysia's Monetary Policy Committee meeting on Thursday.
nb536ba6d13.why: Bank Negara Malaysia sets the country's monetary policy, and its rate decisions influence the ringgit and domestic bond yields.

nf237786510.why: Nestle is a Swiss-headquartered global food and beverage company and one of the largest in the world, so leadership changes can affect investor views of its strategy.
